shots.phrase: Begin by framing Course Foundations & Scope as a question about inputs, decisions, and observable results.
Consider this worked case: Students will use this course to prepare for advanced topics like algorithms, data structures, and software engineering.
List the givens before choosing a method, because an unstated assumption can change the conclusion.
Now define Static vs.
Consider this worked case: In statically typed languages, variable types are checked at compile time, whereas dynamically typed languages check types at runtime.
runtime type resolution.
With the foundation in place, examine how Object-Oriented Design Foundations operates in a concrete sequence.
Consider this worked case: A parent class defines shared behavior, while child classes inherit and extend that behavior through polymorphism.
Follow every arrow in order and name the state before and after each transition.
Next, compare the choices involved in Abstract Data Types & Collections and make the decision criteria explicit.
Consider this worked case: A stack implements last-in-first-out behavior, while a queue implements first-in-first-out behavior for ordered data processing.
Compare alternatives against the same constraints so the evaluation does not move the goalposts.
Apply Software Qualities: Cohesion & Minimal Coupling to a worked situation instead of treating it as an isolated definition.
Consider this worked case: High cohesion means a class performs a single, well-defined purpose, while minimal coupling reduces dependencies between classes.
Work from the concrete inputs to the result, checking units, types, or invariants at each step.
Examine the tradeoffs in Exception Handling & Control Flow, including what improves and what becomes more difficult.
Consider this worked case: A try-catch block catches a runtime error, allowing the program to recover or exit gracefully without crashing.
State the benefit, the cost, and the condition under which the tradeoff is acceptable.
Stress-test the reasoning around Compiler & IR Concepts with an edge case and identify which assumption controls the outcome.
Consider this worked case: LLVM IR serves as a typed, SSA-based intermediate representation that enables cross-platform optimization and code generation.
Change one assumption at a time and observe which part of the reasoning no longer holds.
Use Python Language Model & Execution to diagnose a failure by separating symptoms, causes, and corrective action.
Consider this worked case: Debugging separates syntax, runtime, and logical failures, while decomposition and abstraction reduce interacting concerns in Python code.
Locate the first point where observed behavior diverges from expected behavior, then test the smallest plausible cause.
Connect Object-Oriented Design Patterns to the earlier ideas and explain how the pieces work as one system.
Consider this worked case: The singleton pattern ensures a class has only one instance, while the factory pattern creates objects without specifying exact classes.
Explain each connection explicitly and verify that information retains the same meaning across representations.
Finish with Practical Analysis Checklist as a practical checklist that can guide a new analysis.
Consider this worked case: A checklist evaluates whether each class has a single responsibility, limited dependencies, and clear extension points for future features.
For each checklist item, record the evidence, the remaining uncertainty, and the next verification step.
